session.title: rn that achieves a purpose from a request alone

goals.what: Whoever wants to hand a whole piece of work to an agent asks for it without preparing anything, only answers what they are asked, and their purpose is achieved; rn 0.10.0 brings this to them.
goals.why: Work that takes days then reaches a merged result with the user called only for their own decisions, deciding each sign-off from the proposal alone and going on from the record the next day, as issue #54 says.

acceptance_criteria.what: On real requests, the user sends back few changes at the deliverable sign-off, none once G1 is reached.
On the same requests, the user spends little time from asking to their purpose achieved, with AC1 no worse.

status.next_step: Where it stands, 2026-11-04: T48 done. The user asked (2026-11-04) to remake, before release, the UX, README and architecture of Lane, Pin and Turn, each from a design tree in Pin's form, by the right use of the best practice, then build and test to them until the three can be released (T51). The right use, agreed with the user: a best practice holds the Standard (goal, parts, questions) and, for each question, its Practice (thinking, steps, grounds). 1. Design: the document's goal at the root of a design tree in .rn/20261013-rebuild/design/<plugin>-<kind>.json, the template's questions under it, and under each the decisions that make it yes, each decided by that question's Practice, thinking and steps, its grounds as the reason; Pin's check.py passes; the decisions shown to the user in short lines and approved before any sentence is written. 2. Make: the decisions written along the template's parts, the small points by the Practice's steps; then every question answered as the document's user, a shortfall mended at its decision. 3. Finish: refactor-doc's questions and their Practice steps, the paraphrase test of Q3 among them, the parts kept. 4. Show the finished document; the user agrees before the next. A document is checked by its questions as its reader, never against the code (the user, 2026-11-04). Figures: a sequence in Mermaid (no semicolon inside a message, as Mermaid ends a statement there); every other figure, and a table taken in whole at a glance such as the test table with its ●●● weights, as an SVG in dev/images or beside the document in the style of dev/images/figures.css (python3 dev/scripts/figures.py write); a table looked up by row stays Markdown (refactor-doc.json Q3). A UX scenario shows the user's way from need to gain, the product one closed box, each arrow a few words, never the spec. Turn has two making roles, generator and evaluator: the refactoring phase runs them with the refactoring template, the phase a run value; refactorer and proofreader go, and Lane and the router serve that design, never the reverse. Order: Lane, then Pin, then Turn; in each, UX, README, architecture. Lane's UX, README and architecture are remade so (aca32f63, 23411859, 9af5de0c), the code and tests to follow them with Pin's and Turn's; Pin's UX is next. The user does not review (2026-11-04): the best practices and the three plugins carry the intent, so every point is decided from them and best practice and the work goes through to release-ready; step 4's agreement and step 1's showing are the assistant's own check, each told at the end. Then the code, tests and lanes changed to the documents by .claude/rules/dev.md steps 5 to 8 (code unit tests and architecture tests with doubles; no unit trial of a prompt, the user decided 2026-11-04: a prompt written by prompt.json leaves only the AI's variance and design faults, the rules that must hold are held by Lane's hooks and tested at architecture, and the ux trials, E2E on a subject big enough to bring out the frequent cases, find design faults and measure the variance by the key results; so first change dev/plugin-best-practice.md's Test and its figure, prompt.json Q14 to Q16, and .claude/rules/dev.md step 6c to say so, every file that rests on them with them; e2e-finish's 9a6156d3 and 5d12e281 judged by the E2E), a check in check.sh that each test-table cell and path has its test, Turn's ux trials once, then T51 on the user's word. Also left: the writing pass over every prose file of Lane, Pin and Turn not yet done (hooks' messages, skills, agents, forms, test prompts, changelogs, every comment and docstring), as a bad form left anywhere spreads. rn is out of scope (the user, 2026-11-04): held at 0.8.0, nothing under plugins/rn or dev/rn changed; only the marketplace entry points it to the tag. Well-known OSS tools under a licence such as MIT may be installed for development without asking (the user, 2026-11-04), such as mermaid-cli to check that each Mermaid figure renders.
